tasks.title: Scanner visible square misaligned with decode region (iOS portrait)
tasks.description: Found in SCAN-001 adversarial review: the aspect-square overflow-hidden container crops the video, so on portrait camera streams the centered qrbox extends below the visible area — staff center the QR in the visible square but the decode region sits lower. Plausibly the real root cause of 'scanner does not work' complaints. Candidate fix: pass aspectRatio: 1 in the html5-qrcode config, or size/position from the container's visible box. Needs on-device verification (iOS Safari + Android Chrome).

tasks.title: Camera leak + false 'camera blocked' on rapid scan-mode toggle
tasks.description: Found in SCAN-001 adversarial review: QrScanner cleanup only calls stop() when isScanning is true, which flips after the video 'playing' event. Toggling redeem/stamp during the camera init window skips stop(), leaks the MediaStream (LED stays on, decode loop burns CPU), and the new instance's getUserMedia can fail with NotReadableError on Android — surfacing the misleading 'camera permission denied' card. Fix direction: keep the start() promise in a ref, await it in cleanup, stop tracks unconditionally.

key_insight.summary: Only campaign/template messages cost money. All reactive flows (join, points, receipts, rewards) are free-form within 24h customer service window = FREE.
key_insight.implication: Billing, quotas, and tracking should focus exclusively on campaign sends. Don't rate-limit or track free reactive messages — they drive engagement at zero cost.

free: Customer sends receipt → processing + points reply
Any free-form reply within 24h of customer message
paid: Any business-initiated template message outside 24h window
